query:
SELECT t.id as "id!: Uuid", t.project_id as "project_id!: Uuid", t.title, t.description, t.status as "status!: TaskStatus", t.task_type as "task_type!: TaskType", t.parent_workspace_id as "parent_workspace_id: Uuid", t.parent_task_id as "parent_task_id: Uuid", t.sort_order as "sort_order!: i32", t.plan, t.plan_status, t.is_human as "is_human!: bool", t.routing_decision, t.created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>", t.updated_at as "updated_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
               FROM tasks t
               WHERE t.parent_workspace_id = $1
                 AND t.status = 'ready'
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM task_dependencies td
                     JOIN tasks dep ON dep.id = td.depends_on
                     WHERE td.task_id = t.id AND dep.status != 'done'
                 )
               ORDER BY t.sort_order ASC
               LIMIT 1
